list: the official 55 trophies, names / descriptions / grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on every entry)

trophies.guide: The platinum. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in single-player; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.
No multiplayer or DLC is required, and there are no difficulty settings to worry about.
The list itself is confirmed by the official trackers: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; it cannot be missed.
The mission name is confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy unlocks after completing the first main mission in Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?.
Chapter structure confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2.
The trophy unlocks after completing the first main mission in Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
Chapter structure confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3.
The trophy unlocks after completing the first two main missions in Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Chapter structure confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4.
The trophy unlocks after completing the final main mission in Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
Chapter structure confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the only hidden gold. Finish the final mission of the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Play through to the final mission and complete it.
The trophy pops when the final mission ends; it cannot be missed.
It is the list's only hidden gold trophy.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 and play the main mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; it cannot be missed.
Mission name confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 and play the main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; it cannot be missed.
Mission name confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main mission Child's Play.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; it cannot be missed.
Mission name confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main mission Headliners.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; it cannot be missed.
Mission name confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; it cannot be missed.
Mission name confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Reach Chapter 5 and play the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy unlocks during the mission; it cannot be missed.
Mission name confirmed by the full official list.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. The checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion, but it still takes about 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. Progress made during the story already counts.
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges; you may skip the hardest ten.
Scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles and study any 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars.
Finish any 100 optional missions. The checklist also needs every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy if you want the platinum.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts, mixing the four types: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridges stunts are the quickest to clear; pick the easiest ones first.
Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
Note the count gap: the trophy needs 250, the 100% checklist needs 300, and 397 exist in total.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You will do almost all of them naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see the 9 types and how many of each you have done.
Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them; most are introduced by the story.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold medals are not very difficult.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Visit the 12 shooting ranges around Leonida.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges; every range must be golded.
Shooting ranges are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this comes with the platinum route.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and every location is also needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations around Leonida.
Win at least one drone race at every location.
Drone races are required in full for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can pick the easiest twenty.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Find race locations on the map; there are 40 unique ones.
Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not count twice.
Race wins also count toward the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento after you meet him in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Play the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text message; it marks a fishing location with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Go to the marked spot and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games. You only need to finish all levels of one game once; you do not need every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: There are 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable at the TV in your home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels of one game at least once; pick whichever you like best.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline in Chapter 3. Finish all 5 of Andy's quests in Belville to reach her final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, wait for a call from Andy; she then texts her home address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.
The final quest is the trophy; the whole line stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving line starts in Chapter 1. Clear his 7 shipwrecks and finish his final mission. He goes quiet for a while mid-story but always comes back.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive his marked shipwrecks with the metal detector, dig up the treasure and bring it back to him; there are 7 shipwrecks in total.
Track him under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. He is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Finish his 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, Billy's line is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.
All of his quests stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that actually count. Many optional lines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do NOT count toward this trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Only certain strangers count. Confirmed: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Finish 8 strands across those lines; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
Every stranger stays available after the story in free-roam, so nothing here is missable.
PowerPyx notes there are more strangers yet to be discovered beyond the confirmed ones above, so keep checking new faces in the open world.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 high-end sports cars to him. The first, the Granforma Zorrusso, is delivered during the story mission that unlocks the Key Cloner.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: After Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, Randy gives you a wish list of 16 sports cars; the Zorrusso is already delivered in that mission.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if they are on the list, then drive them to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only line in Chapter 3. Destroy the Synthetic Labs, then shut them down for good in Tyrone's second quest.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: After Chapter 3, Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone's line opens; it is Jason-only, not Lucia.
Go to the purple-marked Synthetic Labs in Vice City and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This; finishing it unlocks the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: MISSABLE STEP: during Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate, then walks to the balcony. Follow her, talk to her and choose Accept.

That balcony meditation raises your counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is currently unclear whether it is required. Do it anyway and keep a manual save from Chapter 1.
Meditate at the other 18 spots across 10 locations; doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts as +2.
You cannot do the final meditation until you can play as both characters, after Chapter 2, Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only hunting line. Meet Bret Vogel in Lummox County after Chapter 2 and hunt the animals he requests. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason (Lucia cannot receive it) and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations.
Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. There are 15 Target Decks in total, all needed for the 100% checklist.
Note: it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so finish the whole line.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Find and collect cards around Leonida; there are 18 collectible card set locations.
Complete any 3 full sets to unlock the trophy.
Cards also feed the Progress Database, so collect more than the minimum while you are out.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with your phone. There are more than 100, so any hundred count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: Hold Up and then R1 to WAiNK-scan objects in the world.
Scan any 100 locations across the types: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
You will scan many naturally while hunting vehicles and collectibles.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You will unlock this on the way to the 70 needed for 100%.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10; you only need 50 for this trophy.
Track them under Progress, Challenges; the completed checkmark shows in the bottom right when you scroll over one.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically while you work toward A Long Road.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level together with your partner. Easiest through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, or it pops naturally during the big bank vault robberies.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Wait until after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone on a fast sports motorcycle.
Easiest route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County; cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping the wanted level. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Wait until after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, then call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while staying chased: keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Rob a couple of items and the back-room safe in each.
The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; there are 557 vehicles at launch.
You need 200 of the 277 base models for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops automatically along the way.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Buff your focus first, use an assault rifle, and pick a gang operation with clustered enemies. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar.
Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, and wear body armor from Ammu-Nations so you can push in close.
Line up 5 enemies, such as criminals at a gang operation, and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556.
Focus has 4 levels and rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a docked passenger plane at Vice City International Airport and fly it 1 km away. Use the plane at departure terminals E3/E4.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal, connected to a boarding bridge; planes parked on the airfield do not work.
Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs and enter the cockpit.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map, and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The tanks stand in the south of the air base; drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Stealth-rob a jewelry store with the Snap Gun. Enter through the back door, loot the safe with its code, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: First finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons.
Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun. Kicking the door triggers the alarm, so use the Snap Gun prompt instead.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. All 8 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the platinum route.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: First finish Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe); it introduces bank vault robberies and does the first one for you.
Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it; bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a cash bag.
After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000 each, after his two Payday Loan jobs); vans are marked purple.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total and they pay up to $205,000 each; you need 5 for this trophy and all 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. It pops automatically in the same mission that unlocks bank vaults, or earlier by blowing a truck's back door open.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Play Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is...; robbing the large bank vault in it counts as robbing an armored truck.
Earlier method: find an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius afterwards; the trophy only pops once you are clear.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep every fogged area.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Fly a plane over every area still covered in black fog on the map until the whole of Leonida is visible.
Exploring also reveals activity icons and collectible spots you will need later.
The trophy pops once the map is fully unfogged.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. All 39 operations are needed for 100%, so this pops on the platinum route.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations; you need just one per gang for this trophy.
Operations are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track each gang under Progress, Gangs; the bottom right shows how many of their operations you have robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window. Only that specific blue Banshee counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: First obtain the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window; the pop is slightly delayed and only this blue Banshee counts.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun, and the safe. You do not need all three in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations; it is marked during Chapter 2, Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations for the safe.
Pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for it; it is not missable.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together so both characters train at once.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Wait until after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Buy a fitness club membership and always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle); while one works out, the other trains automatically.
Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon). Max it for both at the same time.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. It happens passively through robberies and fights; turn on profile notifications to watch it climb.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, On; a small demon face appears whenever an action counts.
Perform 500 profile-affecting actions; the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500.
Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this usually pops naturally. If it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes cops far more aggressive.

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks as of 20 Nov 2026. Do not trust any method you see online yet; this guide will update when one is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner in Little Cuba. That is a belief, not a confirmed method.
KeenGamer also lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, and warns against relying on unverified methods.
Push Square lists only the trophy description, with no method at all.
No source we checked on 20 Nov 2026 confirms a working method. Do not spend hours on guesses; check back for a confirmed update.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg at night after 2AM, north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Come solo; the blinking car spawn is slightly random.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns.
Follow the path into the woods next to the car to find the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it; it drops an abducted woman.
Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: Get on any bike and ride into a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square while riding; you need 10 within 60 seconds.
If the timer runs out, ride to a fresh crowd and try again.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences. Unlock the Dye Pack Jammer first, then rob banks and Payday Loans; Yasmani pays the most.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: First finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew); it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they cost the most.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types; it is cumulative.
Fastest: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios.
Other shops also count: 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 15 electronics stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 total through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. The 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: After Chapter 2, Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app; they cost $160,000 in total.
Robberies are the quick way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first for parking spots, then take cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: After Chapter 2, Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), the Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone.
Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes); each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles.

Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the registration costs down.
